authored_steps.query: MATCH (n) WHERE coalesce(n.attack_id, n.id) IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:HAS_TECHNIQUE]->(m0) WHERE n:Tactic OR NOT (n:Tactic OR n:Technique) WITH n, collect(DISTINCT {m: m0, r: 'HAS_TECHNIQUE'}) AS h0 OPTIONAL MATCH (n)<-[:HAS_TECHNIQUE]-(m1) WHERE n:Technique OR NOT (n:Tactic OR n:Technique) WITH n, h0, collect(DISTINCT {m: m1, r: 'HAS_TECHNIQUE'}) AS h1 WITH n, h0 + h1 AS hops UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(hops) = 0 THEN [{m: null, r: null}] ELSE hops END) AS hop RETURN coalesce(n.attack_id, n.id) AS anchor_id, n.name AS anchor_name, labels(n)[0] AS anchor_label, coalesce(hop.m.attack_id, hop.m.id) AS neighbour_id, hop.m.name AS neighbour_name, labels(hop.m)[0] AS neighbour_label, hop.r AS rel_t
